title: Renew a seasonal vehicle registration
summary: You can renew a seasonal vehicle registration for a first or second quarter (3 months) or a half-year (6 months) term at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If your vehicle is seasonally registered, and you want to renew the registration for a first or second quarter (3 months) or a half-year (6 months) term, you can do so at a Service NSW Centre.

Your existing inspection report can be used to cover quarterly or half-yearly additional registration periods as long as those periods are within 12 months of the report's date.

If the report has expired you'll need a new inspection, either:
who_can_apply: The vehicle must be seasonally registered.
The renewal term must be for a first or second quarter (3 months) or a half-year (6 months).
what_you_need: If not already submitted electronically to Transport for NSW, a completed Replacement Application – PDF (if you are not the first or second registered operator).

more_info.text: You can renew seasonal registration up to 12 months after the expiry date.

faqs.q: Can I use my existing inspection report for renewal?
faqs.a: Yes, your existing inspection report can be used for quarterly or half-yearly additional registration periods, provided those periods are within 12 months of the report's date.

faqs.q: What do I need if my inspection report has expired?
faqs.a: If the report has expired, you will need to complete a new inspection.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to renew my seasonal vehicle registration?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, your concession details (if applicable), and if you are not the first or second registered operator, a completed Replacement Application – PDF.
